# Vagdevi Food Products Private Limited

> Rice millers and exporters at Yadgarpally, Miryalaguda, in the Nalgonda district of
> Telangana, India. Paddy is procured directly from farmers in the surrounding mandals and
> is dried, milled, graded, colour-sorted and packed on a single ISO 22000:2018 certified
> site. The company supplies bulk buyers, private-label brands and export customers.

Incorporated 15 September 2017.

## Location and contact

- IEC — AAGCV1018C

## Products

Three rice varieties, each available steam or double boiled, in 10, 26 and 30 kg packs
(50 kg for bulk consignments on request):

- JSR (Lachkari Kolam) — medium slender grain, cooks fluffy and separate
- HMT (Sona Masoori / Ponni type) — fine, light, easily digestible
- RNR (Telangana Sona) — short-duration variety with a low glycaemic index

By-products: rice bran, broken rice (fine and coarse), husk.

Consumer brands: Surya (eight pack colours; pink is JSR, black is HMT boiled) and Dwaraka
(short thick grain for idli and dosa fermentation).

Markets served: Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Telangana.
